reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: As well as a full redecoration there was damage repairs required from a roof leak which were handled brilliantly. Tom was very helpful. It’s easy to recommend this company as they provided an excellent service.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: My kitchen had been exhibiting damp in multiple places over many years and I couldn't seem to fix the problem. Tom and his team surveyed and diagnosed the problem and set to work on the external problem (which was structural) and then fixed the internal problem which was cosmetic. An excellent job. His team is so professional and polite and I'd strongly recommend them to anyone.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Leaks, leaks and more leaks over many years. Tom and his team fixed this chronic challenge in a very short period of time and also repainted the kitchen as well so I got even more benefit than I signed up for. The team were lovely, hard working and very skilled. The kitchen is now a joy to be in come rain or shine. Thanks Guys!!
items.label: Which? review
